ingredients.title: Additional toppings
items: 4 oz chocolate candy coating (can use chocolate chips)

instructions.title: Brownies
items: Cream butter and sugar together. Add eggs and vanilla and blend well.
Add salt, cocoa and flour and stir to combine. Don't overbeat.
Pour into a greased 9x13 pan. Bake at 350°F for 20-25 minutes. Let cool completely.

instructions.title: Salted caramel buttercream
items: Add powdered sugar, salt, vanilla, caramel and milk to stand mixer and mix until well combined.
Add more milk and/or powdered sugar as needed to reach desired consistency.
Frost the tops of completely cooled brownies.

instructions.title: Additional toppings
items: Sprinkle toasted coconut evenly over the top of buttercream.
Melt chocolate candy coating in 30-second increments, stirring in between until smooth and melted.
Combine caramel bits and water in microwave-safe bowl and microwave for 45 seconds. Stir until smooth and well combined.
Drizzle melted chocolate candy coating and caramel over toasted coconut.

notes.title: Open questions
items: The buttercream vanilla has no amount ("tsp. vanilla"). How much?
